Our stores

Harrow & Finch Grocers runs 62 supermarkets across the province. Every store has a fresh produce department, an in-store bakery and a butcher counter, and every store is supplied six days a week.

This autumn a second distribution centre opens to supply the fresh departments of 24 stores in the north. We have set a target to halve food waste by 2032 and we publish the figure for each store.

Find your nearest store with the store locator, or ask at the service desk about opening hours, parking and home delivery in your area.
